'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Moller DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Moller]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Ability 3
* '''Username:''' Hellhungseen
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
